title: BabysitFinding
description: Schema for findings reported by Monitor observing Argon, proxy, pool, and refresher

confidence.description: Confidence score based strictly on concrete evidence

summary.description: Concise factual summary of the observation

request_id.description: Exact request_id from proxy debug record (or 'n/a' if system event)

quoted_log.description: Verbatim quote from proxy log, timeline, or refresher log

metric_name.description: Optional metric key (e.g. ttft_ms, error_class, max_inter_chunk_gap_ms)

task_id.description: Task ID associated with this finding, if applicable

root_cause_hypothesis.description: Plausible explanation of cause, explicitly labelled as hypothesis

proposed_fix.description: Actionable engineering recommendation to prevent or resolve the issue

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when finding was authored
